2609.29951.title: Tracking States or Tracking Cosets? An Algebraic Account of Learned State Tracking
2609.29951.paper_summary: State tracking requires composing a sequence of updates, but accuracy alone does not reveal what a model has learned. We study neural networks trained to predict the running product of group elements. We identify quotient solutions in Transformers, where models recover the quotient class while predicting nearly uniformly among its members. The reciprocal of class size predicts partial accuracy without a fitted parameter, extending parity-based accounts to non-parity quotients. Our baseline Transformers' predictions change little under prefix reordering beyond the exact-tracking frontier. We prove that, for finite groups under uniform i.i.d. full-group inputs, optimal order-blind exact accuracy converges to the reciprocal of abelianization class size as prefix length grows, consistent with the observed abelianization plateaus. Sequential updates permit more: any partition into right cosets of a subgroup, normal or not, survives sequential updates. In our census of standard Transformers, every recovered coset partition comes from a normal subgroup, whereas parameter-matched recurrent networks pass through both normal and non-normal right-coset stages during training. On $A_5$, we identify low-dimensional subspaces of the recurrent state that encode non-normal cosets. In the three-dimensional cases, coset mean vectors form approximate dodecahedra, and swapping the state components in these subspaces transfers the donor's coset state through a shared input suffix. Our results connect partial accuracy, learning stages, and internal computation through the subgroup cosets that models learn to track.
2609.29951.paper_summary_zh: 狀態追蹤需要組成一系列的更新，但僅僅依賴準確性並不能揭示模型所學到的內容。我們研究了訓練用於預測群元素運行積的神經網絡。我們在Transformer中識別了商類解決方案，模型在預測其成員時幾乎均勻地恢復商類。類大小的倒數在沒有擬合參數的情況下預測部分準確性，將基於奇偶性的解釋擴展到非奇偶商類。我們的基準Transformer的預測在前綴重排序下幾乎沒有變化，超出了精確追蹤的邊界。我們證明，對於在均勻獨立同分佈的全群輸入下的有限群，最佳的無序精確準確性隨著前綴長度的增長而收斂到阿貝爾化類大小的倒數，這與觀察到的阿貝爾化平台一致。序列更新允許更多：任何對子群的右陪集的劃分，無論是否正常，都能在序列更新中存活。在我們的標準Transformer普查中，每個恢復的陪集劃分都來自一個正常子群，而參數匹配的遞歸網絡在訓練過程中經歷正常和非正常的右陪集階段。在 $A_5$ 上，我們識別了編碼非正常陪集的遞歸狀態的低維子空間。在三維情況下，陪集均值向量形成近似的十二面體，並且在這些子空間中交換狀態組件會通過共享輸入後綴轉移捐贈者的陪集狀態。我們的結果通過模型學會追蹤的子群陪集，將部分準確性、學習階段和內部計算聯繫起來。
2609.29951.author: Zhiyu Zhang et.al.
